tenderSchedule.title: RE-TENDER FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION AND COMMISSIONING OF 01 NO REREELING , 02 NOS DENIER SCALE MACHINE DIGITAL, 01 NO JUTE WASTE DRIER MACHINE AND 02 NOS COCOON PEELING MACHINE AT KSIC T.NARASIPURA,
tenderSchedule.description: RE-TENDER FOR SUPPLY, INSTALLATION AND COMMISSIONING OF 01 NO REREELING MACHINE 40 WINDOWS, 02 NOS DENIER SCALE MACHINE DIGITAL, 01 NO JUTE WASTE DRIER MACHINE AND 02 NOS COCOON PEELING MACHINE AT KSIC UNIT SILK FILATURE, T.NARASIPURA, KARNATAKA STATE

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should furnish the information of all past supplies and satisfactory performance for both (a) and (b) above, in proforma under Section- XII

The minimum Turnover of the Tenderer shall be Rs. 25 Lakhs during last 3 financial years and furnish supporting documents like profit & loss account certified by a chartered accountant as a proof of turnover and financial status

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be an authorized dealer/agent of manufacturer/manufacturer who must have manufactured/supplied, tested the equipment (s) at least 02 No Re-Reeling Machine (40 Windows), 03 Nos Denier Scale Machine (Digital), 02 No Jute Waste Drier Machine and 03 Nos Cocoon Peeling Machine during the last 3 financial years as per the technical specifications in Section VI for the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements. The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released after 2022 and be in satisfactory operation for at least 3 years as on date of tender opening. (a)Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative/dealer of a manufacturer, meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided(b)The manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC
The tenderer should be an authorized dealer/agent of manufacturer/manufacturer having a valid GST registration and Copies to be enclosed
